pages.text: Almost every boss gives each player nearby (64 blocks) their own $(item)trophy$() when it falls. Quests check for trophies, so the whole group gets credit, not only whoever landed the last hit.$(br2)Keep them: some raise your world tier.

$(li)Amethyst Crab: Geode Claw$(li)Ancient Remnant: Sun-Bleached Fang$(li)Maledictus: Frostbound Crown$(li)Leviathan: Abyssal Scale$(li)Netherite Monstrosity: Molten Heart$(li)Ender Guardian: Citadel Keystone$(li)Ender Dragon: Dragonscale$(li)Wither: Ashen Skull Shard

Optional Overworld bosses:$(li)Ferrous Wroughtnaut: Wrought Rivet$(li)Frostmaw: Rimefang Tusk$(li)Umvuthi: Sunbird Plume$(li)Sandworm: Dune Fang$(li)Yeti: Hoarfrost Pelt$(li)Kraken: Abyssal Ink$(li)Infernal Dragon: Cinder Scale$(li)Corrupted Champion: Champion's Tarnished Crest
Optional Nether and End bosses:$(li)Underworld Knight: Oathbreaker Seal$(li)Gauntlet: Gauntlet Core$(li)Night Lich: Phylactery Shard$(li)Void Blossom: Void Petal$(li)Obsidilith: Obsidian Heartstone
